text: Added a resumable full-court driver at modules/benchmarks/python/run_performance_court.py. It runs correctness before timing; fingerprints core/benchmark source, configuration, and Java/Node/Python/NumPy runtime environment; checksum-verifies phase outputs; re-qualifies the host before each JVM, NumPy, JMH GC, Node, and Node trace-GC phase; fails closed with a resumable host_blocked manifest; and records commands, logs, snapshots, and artifacts. Added an absolute first-baseline Node report with every row and family normalized geomeans. Timing evidence now rejects fewer than five samples and metadata/row sample-count mismatches, so the prior one-sample smoke cannot masquerade as zero-variance evidence. Documented the managed receipt workflow and Scala.js implications. Verification: all 23 benchmark Python tests pass, ruff check and format check pass on changed Python, py_compile passes, driver dry-run/list-phases pass, and git diff --check is clean. The long receipt remains pending.
